scientific_integrity: All conclusions are supported by a closed-form transfer proof, exact rational inequalities, and independently rerunnable standard-library code; no computational observation is extrapolated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The proof computes signed Euler and total rational homology lower bounds; it does not classify homology degrees, homotopy types, or torsion, and no independent or exhaustive publication-priority audit was performed.
title: Exponential homology growth in circular-ladder two-independence complexes
